head_commit.message:
BUG-0068 (secondary 2): normalize markdown-decorated Verify criteria before running

Wave docs may declare Verify criteria as prose bullets; the verifier ran
the raw section as one shell command and died with 'Illegal option -' —
W0 (14:26) and both W1 verification jobs failed this way, blocking the
campaign. normalize-declared-verify passes canonical declarations through
byte-for-byte; decorated ones get their code spans extracted and joined
with && (every declared command must be green). 29/29 verifier tests.

  invisible while the transcript still said 'Type /retry to resubmit')

  session, the hint states the automatic re-attempt instead of advising
  manual /retry; non-campaign hints byte-for-byte unchanged

  tui-init from current-gsd-campaign-owner's dynamic extent
- emit-infra-retry-event! passes remaining patience at the slow-lane site

  README metrics resynced from the branch tree; tests: boundaries suite
  extended (hint + reducer cases), 39/39; slow-lane 63/63; go-orch 63/63
